text: dsh-ui-outline 是用于 DSH 网页端及复用网页客户端的界面插件，为长对话加入贴合会话列边缘的轮次导航轨和 Spotlight 风格搜索。它在 shell.overlay 注册导航轨、预览与搜索界面，并通过插件设置卡片调整位置、刻度密度和玻璃材质。用户可以悬停查看轮次内容、滚动或拖动定位，并用快捷键搜索当前对话。适合需要在长会话中快速回看上下文的 DSH 用户；无需额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-ui-outline adds turn navigation and search to DSH web and embedded desktop clients. Its rail previews and jumps between turns in long chats; Cmd/Ctrl+F searches the current conversation. Settings control rail position, density, and preview material. No API key or external service is required.
长对话太长了，想按轮次快速跳到前面的内容。
能不能在会话旁边显示一个可拖动的对话大纲？
我想先悬停预览某一轮，再决定要不要跳过去。
希望滚动导航轨就能逐轮浏览，不用反复翻聊天记录。
怎么在当前 DSH 对话里搜索关键词？
想用快捷键搜会话，并用键盘选择命中结果。
I need a turn-by-turn rail to jump around a long chat.
Can I search messages in the current DSH conversation?
dsh-ui-outline 的功能「轮次导航」：在当前会话列边缘显示轮次轨道，用户可通过点击或拖动定位到对应轮次，便于长对话快速跳转。
dsh-ui-outline 的功能「悬停预览」：指向轨道刻度时查看该轮提问和回答的预览，再决定是否跳转到目标轮次。
dsh-ui-outline 的功能「对话搜索」：按 Cmd/Ctrl+F 打开当前对话搜索，空格分隔的词按 AND 匹配，并显示带上下文的命中片段。
dsh-ui-outline 的功能「轨道外观设置」：通过插件配置调整轨道左右位置、紧凑或宽松刻度，以及预览材质和透明度、模糊参数。

dsh-ui-outline README · 导航轨，按你的阅读习惯摆放：轨道贴合会话列边缘，停靠左缘或右缘完全由你决定。两种刻度密度各展所长：**宽松**排布刻度疏朗直观、轮次一眼可数；**紧凑**排布则能将上百轮对话容纳于一屏，超出后亦可在轨内平滑滚动。整条轨道具宽域磁吸，无需费力瞄准细线；随手点击或按住拖动，皆可连续自如地穿梭其间。
section: 导航轨，按你的阅读习惯摆放

text: dsh-ui-outline README · 悬停预览，滚轮速览：鼠标拂过刻度，玻璃预览卡便浮现该轮的提问与回答，不必跳转即可确认上下文。在轨道上滑动滚轮可逐轮步进：虚线游标与预览卡紧随指尖移动，而**当前正在阅读的会话主体始终原地不动**。锁定目标后轻点或回车直达，落点伴有闪光指示——先探查、再落定，长对话里无需反复翻页。
dsh-ui-outline README · 列再窄，导航也不退场：分屏阅读或展开侧栏时，会话列常被大幅压缩，原生导航往往随之隐去；而本轨默认贴靠列边缘坚守，快速跳转永不中断。若偏好极致沉浸的阅读视野，亦可在设置中设为窄列隐藏。收起后列缘仍会留存一枚克制的开关，随时轻点即可再次唤出。

dsh-ui-outline README · ⌘F / Ctrl+F，搜索当前对话：按下快捷键唤出 Spotlight 搜索条；键入字符瞬间，跑道胶囊顺着固有圆角向下平滑生长为玻璃结果卡片。支持空格分词 AND 检索与中英混排，命中的上下文词块精准高亮，并全程由纯键盘高效驱动（`↑` `↓` 切换、`↵` 闪光跳转、`Esc` 退出）。后台分片构建索引杜绝输入卡顿，且搜索浮层与预览卡同样支持毛玻璃、液态玻璃及不透明等多种材质实时切换。 三种材质并排看：不透明、毛玻璃、液态玻璃——同一轮内容，不同质感。

dsh-ui-outline README · ⌘F / Ctrl+F，搜索当前对话：

交互细节 - 搜索浮层胶囊高 52px，折叠与展开共用 26px 圆角，形变是纯高度生长、圆角全程不动。 - 滚轮步进：空查询起点为当前轮；100 归一化滚动单位/轮，150ms 静止清零余量；拖拽/聚焦即时接管游标。 - 输入 60ms 防抖 + 分片扫描，首字符到结果的延迟与对话长度基本无关。 - 液态玻璃搜索浮层的实际模糊不低于 10px，保证文字可读性。

dsh-ui-outline README · 安装：需要 dsh `>= 0.2.0-rc.1`。支持网页端，以及复用同一 web client 的桌面端。 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ui-outline ``` 安装后重启 `dsh web` 并刷新页面。
其他安装方式 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:iluluyu/dsh-ui-outline dsh plugin --profile web add . # 在插件目录下执行；相对路径以当前执行位置为准 dsh plugin --profile web add file:/absolute/path/to/plugin ``` 卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-ui-outline`。

dsh-ui-outline README · 设置：在 **插件 → dsh-ui-outline** 中调整，全部即时生效。 | 设置 | 选项与默认值 | | --- | --- | | 停靠边缘 | 左侧 / 右侧；默认右侧 | | 刻度密度 | 紧凑 `compact` / 宽松 `loose`；默认紧凑 | | 预览材质 | 不透明 `none` / 毛玻璃 `frost` / 液态玻璃 `liquid`；默认毛玻璃 | | 窄列显示 | 显示 / 隐藏；默认显示 |
材质参数 毛玻璃默认透明度 **80**、模糊 **6**；液态玻璃更薄透，标准预设为透明度 **75**、模糊 **4**。**清透 / 标准 / 朦胧**预设一次更新两项，不闪出自定义滑条。搜索浮层跟随预览材质设置。

dsh-ui-outline README · dsh-ui-outline：Never lose your place in long conversations. Place the rail your way, keep navigation in narrow columns, and search instantly with ⌘F / Ctrl+F. A turn navigation rail and conversation search for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

dsh-ui-outline README · A rail that fits how you read：The rail hugs either edge of the conversation column, letting you combine docking side and tick density to match your reading habits. As illustrated below, **loose** density keeps ticks spaced and countable at a glance, while **compact** density accommodates hundreds of turns within a single viewport with smooth internal scrolling. The hit strip offers generous magnetic snapping so you never have to target thin lines—click anywhere or drag freely to glide across the session.

text: dsh-ui-outline README · Hover previews, wheel-speed browsing：Hover over any tick to reveal a frosted glass card showing that turn's prompt and response, confirming context before you jump. Rolling the wheel over the rail steps through turns sequentially: the dashed cursor and preview card travel with your scroll while **the conversation itself remains completely still**. Once you spot your target, click or press Enter to land with a subtle flash—glance first, commit second, eliminating weary back-and-forth paging in long sessions.
dsh-ui-outline README · Hover previews, wheel-speed browsing：

dsh-ui-outline README · Navigation that stays in narrow columns：Splitting your screen or opening a sidebar shrinks the conversation column and typically collapses native navigation; this rail stays pinned to the edge by default so rapid jumps never vanish. If you prefer an uncluttered reading layout, narrow columns can be configured to hide the rail automatically. Even when stowed, a subtle edge toggle remains in place so you can summon it back whenever needed.
section: Navigation that stays in narrow columns

text: dsh-ui-outline README · ⌘F / Ctrl+F to search the conversation：Press the shortcut to call up a Spotlight search bar; on the first keystroke, the capsule morphs seamlessly downward into a glass result card with identical corner curves. It supports whitespace-delimited AND matching across languages with highlighted context snippets, fully operable via keyboard (`↑` `↓` to navigate, `↵` to jump with a flash, `Esc` to dismiss). Background sliced indexing ensures silky typing regardless of conversation depth, while both the overlay and preview cards support live-switchable frosted glass, liquid glass, and opaque finishes.
dsh-ui-outline README · ⌘F / Ctrl+F to search the conversation：Three materials side by side — opaque, frosted glass, and liquid glass — over the same turn:

dsh-ui-outline README · ⌘F / Ctrl+F to search the conversation：- The search capsule is 52px high and shares one 26px corner radius across both states; the morph is a pure height growth with the radius never changing.
- Wheel stepping: starts at the current turn; 100 normalized scroll units per step with a 150ms idle remainder reset; drags and focus take the cursor over instantly.
- A 60ms input debounce plus sliced scanning keeps first-keystroke-to-results latency independent of conversation length.
- Liquid-glass search keeps a minimum effective blur of 10px for readability.

dsh-ui-outline README · Settings：Open **Plugins → dsh-ui-outline**; every option applies live. | Setting | Options and defaults | | --- | --- | | Dock edge | Left / Right; defaults to Right | | Tick density | Compact `compact` / Loose `loose`; defaults to Compact | | Preview material | Opaque `none` / Frosted glass `frost` / Liquid glass `liquid`; defaults to Frosted glass | | Narrow-column visibility | Show / Hide; defaults to Show |
Material parameters

dsh-ui-outline README · Settings：Frosted glass defaults to transparency **80**, blur **6**; liquid glass is thinner, with its Standard preset at transparency **75**, blur **4**. The **Airy / Standard / Misty** presets update both values together without flashing the custom sliders. The search overlay follows the preview material setting.
